cues: Keep pushing knees out into the band

summary: This is a front-on banded squat with good control: the right knee tracks well over the foot, weight looks evenly shared, and the hips stay level. The camera seems to move slightly between frames, so small differences may be missed; a steady phone at hip height would help. These are observations to discuss with your physio, not a diagnosis.
